message: Turn 46 fixed at dc5422a3f78d81d2b566be8457c57df32964fb47, Dispatcher 2.2.15. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_resume.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_blank.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_rebind.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_restore.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_resume.py test_control_blank.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_rebind.py test_control_page.py test_control_restore.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_resume.py printed test_control_resume: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_rebind.py printed test_control_rebind: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_blank.py printed test_control_blank: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_restore.py printed test_control_restore: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Resume semantics: a new rebind page is not failed on the first composer miss. After goto, the already-created marked page is polled for up to 20s at 0.5s. signed_out or hard_unavailable fails closed immediately. no_composer is stored only after the full wait. If the composer becomes ready, CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP is sent once only when rebind_bootstrap_sent is false, then a usable /c/ URL is required. ChatGPT home '/' is never persisted. New failures store a stable rebind_failure_reason token (no_composer, signed_out, hard_unavailable, no_new_url, goto, missing_page, unexpected_url) and do not resume. The current 2.2.14 state rebind_status=failed, rebind_count=1, rebind_bootstrap_sent=false, and no stored failure reason gets exactly one resume. The latch rebind_resume_count/rebind_resume_status/rebind_resume_for_url is written before the wait, so a restart or later poll cannot repeat it. Resume uses only the existing ai-dispatcher-rebind page and never calls new_page. If that page is missing, the latch is consumed with reason=missing_page and no tab is opened. If the marked page is already on https://chatgpt.com/, it is not navigated again. A different conversation URL is not navigated and fails as unexpected_url. Signed-out and hard-unavailable still gate the wait. A stored failure reason, rebind_bootstrap_sent=true, or resume_count>=1 blocks another resume. The normal rebind path still returns wait for a failed latch and does not create a second page. Recovery, bootstrap history, and GitHub fetch state are preserved. Successful rebind still clears only blank and restore latches. CHECK_INTERVAL stays 5. The 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover is unchanged. Logs contain tokens only, not UI text. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
